_readme: Product-Specific Terms, keyed by template id. Anything listed here is shown on the product page and inside the purchase confirmation, on top of the Standard Licence. Shape: { "<id>": { "name"?: string, "productionWebsites"?: number, "endProducts"?: number, "productTerms"?: string[] } }.

productTerms: This is The7 Classic, the legacy release of the theme. It is not the current product generation.
The author provides security and essential maintenance updates only. The7 Classic is no longer tested against new major versions of WordPress, PHP, Elementor, WPBakery or WooCommerce.
Any upgrade path to a newer product generation is offered by the theme author on their own terms and is not part of this purchase.
